title: Detailed lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hanging hook -->
  <path d='M50 4 C50 4 46 12 46 16 L54 16 C54 12 50 4 50 4 Z' fill='#C0A840'/>
  <rect x='47' y='15' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#E0C860'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <path d='M38 22 L50 17 L62 22 L60 26 L40 26 Z' fill='#D4A820'/>
  <rect x='38' y='25' width='24' height='5' rx='1' fill='#F0D050'/>
  <!-- top ring band -->
  <rect x='34' y='29' width='32' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E8C040'/>
  <rect x='34' y='29' width='32' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FCE880'/>
  <!-- glass body -->
  <rect x='36' y='35' width='28' height='36' rx='6' fill='#FFD966' opacity='0.35'/>
  <rect x='36' y='35' width='28' height='36' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#FFBF3A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- vertical frame bars -->
  <rect x='35' y='35' width='3' height='36' rx='1.5' fill='#E0A820'/>
  <rect x='62' y='35' width='3' height='36' rx='1.5' fill='#E0A820'/>
  <!-- inner glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#FFF4B0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#FFFBE8'/>
  <!-- flame -->
  <path d='M50 42 C47 48 48 54 50 58 C52 54 53 48 50 42 Z' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <path d='M50 46 C49 50 49.5 54 50 56 C50.5 54 51 50 50 46 Z' fill='#FFE060'/>
  <!-- wick -->
  <rect x='49.5' y='58' width='1' height='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- bottom ring band -->
  <rect x='34' y='69' width='32' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E8C040'/>
  <rect x='34' y='73' width='32' height='2' rx='1' fill='#C0A030'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='37' y='75' width='26' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#F0D050'/>
  <path d='M38 80 L50 85 L62 80 L60 76 L40 76 Z' fill='#D4A820'/>
  <!-- decorative dots on bands -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#FFF4B0'/>
  <!-- tassel -->
  <rect x='49' y='85' width='2' height='4' fill='#C03030'/>
  <path d='M46 89 L50 94 L54 89 Z' fill='#E04040'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='94' r='2' fill='#C03030'/>
  <!-- side glow accents -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='48' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#FFF0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='48' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#FFF0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
